claims.text: The resort is in the coastal neighbourhood of Glyfada, in southern Athens.

findings.quote: One&Only Aesthesis is located in the coastal neighbourhood of Glyfada, in southern Athens

claims.text: The resort recalls the 1960s heyday of the Athenian Riviera.

findings.quote: One&Only Aesthesis recalls the 1960s heyday of the Athenian Riviera

claims.text: Architectural firms AUDO, A6Architects and K-Studio, with interior design studio Muza Lab, created the resort.

findings.quote: Three acclaimed architectural firms – AUDO, A6Architects, and K-Studio – along with interior design studio Muza Lab, brought One&Only Aesthesis to life

claims.text: The resort offers transfers in luxury vehicles from Athens International Airport, Piraeus Port and central Athens, each a 30-minute drive away.

findings.quote: We provide convenient transfers in luxury vehicles from Athens International Airport, Piraeus Port and the centre of Athens, all 30 minutes' drive from the resort.

claims.text: The resort is pet-friendly and caters to dogs.

findings.quote: our pet-friendly resort, where your canine companion will be completely catered to

claims.text: The boat trip from the sister resort on Kea Island takes 45 minutes.

findings.quote: The boat trip from One&Only Kéa Island takes 45 minutes.

claims.text: Winters on the Athenian Riviera are mild, and sea swimming is still possible in early to mid October.

findings.quote: Winters on the Athenian Riviera are refreshingly mild; thanks to warm temperatures, you can still swim in the sea in early–mid October.

claims.text: Bungalows are dotted around the grounds; some are right on the sea, others surrounded by rosemary, bougainvillea and olive trees.

findings.quote: Most guests will stay in the 95 bungalows dotted around the grounds. Some are right on the sea, others enveloped in rosemary, bougainvillea, and olive trees.

claims.text: Connected to the spa are a Technogym fitness centre, a yoga pavilion and an outdoor lap pool.

findings.quote: Connected to the spa is a Technogym fitness centre, yoga pavilion, and an outdoor lap pool

claims.text: Every guest has two dedicated hosts, on call around the clock via WhatsApp.

findings.quote: Every guest has two dedicated hosts, on-call round-the-clock (via What’s App)

claims.text: At Ora restaurant most dishes are wood-fired or cooked on the parilla grill.

findings.quote: By night, Ora’s lemon-yellow booths
most dishes are wood-fired or cooked on the parilla grill

claims.text: The resort has padel and tennis courts and non-motorized watersports, including stand-up paddle board and windsurfing lessons.

findings.quote: There are Padel and tennis courts and non-motorized watersports, including stand-up paddle board or windsurfing lessons

claims.text: Bungalow outdoor areas have a private pool, loungers, an outdoor shower and a fireplace.

findings.quote: Most guests will stay in the 95 bungalows dotted around the grounds.
It’s the alfresco areas—private pool, plentiful loungers, outdoor shower, and fireplace—that really elevate the spaces.

claims.text: The design stays true to the essence of the Asteria beach club from the 1950s, which in the 1950s and '60s was a playground for socialites and starlets.

findings.quote: staying true to the essence of the iconic Asteria beach club from the 1950s
Asteria—meaning ‘stars’ in Greek—was a playground for socialites and starlets

claims.text: The spa is a Guerlain spa, with treatments featuring Guerlain's signature scents and a Glamour Studio for simultaneous hair, make-up and nail rituals.

findings.quote: The light and luscious Guerlain spa
Treatments feature Guerlain’s signature scents
The Glamour Studio for simultaneous hair, make-up, and nail rituals

claims.text: A protected forest within the resort's boundaries remains untouched.

findings.quote: A protected forest within the boundaries of the resort remains untouched.

claims.text: Private museum tours, sandal-making workshops and boat trips to the nearby islands of Aegina and Kea can be arranged.

findings.quote: Private museum tours, sandal-making workshops, and boat trips to the nearby islands of Aegina and Kea

claims.text: The resort is separated from Glyfada's shops and restaurants by six-lane Poseidonos Avenue, which has heavy traffic.

findings.quote: The resort is separated from the neighborhood’s upscale boutiques and fast-food restaurants by six-lane Poseidonos Avenue, with thundering traffic around the clock.
